1.title: 1. Purpose
1.text: Tantara lets relatives record their voice on stories and lets children listen to them, within a family. [Publisher name, address, contact].

2.title: 2. Account and family
2.text: A parent creates the family and invites other parents or relatives by e-mail or by code. A child has no account of their own: their profile is managed by their parents.

3.title: 3. Recorded content
3.text: Everyone stays responsible for their recordings. An adult can leave up to 5 messages for the same child. Parents can review, refuse or remove any content.

4.title: 4. Rules of use
4.text: Content must suit a young audience. Recording someone’s voice without their consent or publishing unlawful content is forbidden.

5.title: 5. Deletion
5.text: A parent can remove a relative, a child or a book at any time. The account can be deleted from the settings. [Retention period].

6.title: 6. Liability and changes
6.text: [To be completed: service availability, limitation of liability, changes to the terms, applicable law.]

1.title: Data collected
1.text: Adults’ e-mail address, the child’s first name and age, profile photo (silly face), recorded voices, reading progress, favourites, chosen languages. A cookie-free audience measurement (GoatCounter) counts page views in aggregate, with no IP address or identifier, and can be switched off.

2.title: Children’s data
2.text: It is only collected with the consent of a parent or legal guardian, is never used for advertising and is never resold. No profiling.

3.title: Purposes
3.text: To make the app work: listening, recording, review, notifications chosen by each person.

4.title: Hosting and duration
4.text: [Host, country]. Data is kept as long as the family exists, then deleted within [duration].

5.title: Your rights
5.text: Access, correction, erasure, export and objection, from the settings or at [contact address]. You may complain to your data protection authority.

6.title: Device permissions
6.text: Microphone to record, camera or photos for the profile picture, notifications if enabled. Each one can be refused.
